limitations: The manifest admits map-like roots broadly because extension evidence cannot represent both renamed mounted roots and packed .SC2Map files; the bounded structural detector is authoritative.
Packed file and archive-entry sources require a host content resolver that exposes mounted map entries; the semantic codec does not decode raw MPQ bytes itself.

Detection is portable, but the current semantic runtime is conservatively Node-only because its transitive @modkitx/maps-processing/sc2-map-core and @modkitx/maps-processing/sc2-map-image compatibility imports are not browser-classified by the repository validator.

The runtime renders implemented 2D map layers and extracts mounted entries. Objects/Preload reference rename has a codec-owned edit transaction but requires sc2-mod to supply the coordinating catalog rename; 3D scene construction, map packing, and source save-as remain unavailable.
Map launch is available only through the Node adapter for a local .SC2Map source and requires a StarCraft II installation plus process-launch permission.
